content.shortDescription: Paste a Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music playlist and see which of your artists play Amsterdam Dance Event 2026, when and where.
content.fullDescription:
A free planner for Amsterdam Dance Event. Paste a public playlist link or a list of artist names and it reads every track, matches the artists against the full ADE 2026 program and lays out your week night by night, with venues, set times and ticket links.

It suggests similar artists on the lineup, lets you star events into a personal plan, and has a separate daytime tab for talks, workshops and ADE Pro networking sessions. The program syncs into VAMS, my own content platform, so the site stays fast and keeps working even when the source is down.

Built with Nuxt on Netlify. No login: your plan stays in your browser.

content.shortDescription: An application used by clinics to manage schedules and provide information to doctors and clients.
content.fullDescription:
An application used by clinics to manage schedules and provide information to doctors and clients. Its features include: ***a calendar module where doctors' timeslots are booked and in these timeslots, patients' appointments can be booked. *** Real time communications and notifications for doctors, patients, and the clinic administrator. *** 

It also allows patients to share their medical info, pain indications, and messages with their doctor.

content.shortDescription: A free, fast MP3 pack player for DJs: audition a folder of tracks with waveforms, EQ and instant BPM and key.
content.fullDescription:
Qinip is a desktop app for DJs who dig through sample packs and promo folders. Drop in a folder of MP3s and it plays them back to back without gaps, draws a coloured waveform per frequency band, and works out BPM, key and Camelot number in the background so you can sort and pick tracks fast. A 4-band EQ, tag editing and keyboard shortcuts keep your hands on the keys.

Built in Rust for macOS and Windows, so it starts instantly and stays light while analysing hundreds of tracks.

content.fullDescription: A fullstack application designed for a company that organizes medical events around the globe. content.shortDescription: An application whose purpose is to inform users about the exact colors used in an image.
content.fullDescription:
An application whose purpose is to inform users about the exact colors used in an image. In addition it will try and group the colors by parent and can show you the results of the analysis of multiple images, each image's results as well as an overall analysis.

To successfully develop this project, knowledge of color spaces, perception and color matching algorithms had to be acquired.
